text.en:
The item regarding the municipal Port of Calbayog in section two, paragraph (b), item 45 of Republic act Numbered Nine hundred is amended is to read as follows:
"45. Calbayog, Samar ₱149,000.00"
Item 41, section two, paragraph (a) and items 48, 53 54, 110, 111, 112 and 113 in section two, paragraph (b), are hereby cancelled.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1954.
